items.title: Paquito D'Rivera — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I wanted Alex Blake to play bass, but he was very busy with the Manhattan Transfer in those days, at the beginning of the time, I asked him, and he recommended Russel Blake.

ctx.x: Who were the musicians that you got to play on that record?

Well, mainly the quintet that I have in those days, was uh, Hilton Ruiz, eh, Russell Blake was playing bass, I wanted Alex Blake to play bass, but he was very busy with the Manhattan Transfer in those days, at the beginning of the time, I asked him, and he recommended Russel Blake.
